supplement: OASIS G3.2 Live Execution Supplement v1
purpose: Host-side execution completion for the frozen G3.2 design; this supplement does not introduce a new OASIS theory and does not constitute CARLA empirical evidence.
implemented_live_chain: Pareto-partial-order verification depth and resource demand
exactly one realization per Decision Epoch
multiple pending Decision Epoch realizations within a continuing front Relation Episode
actual realized Closed relation history admission
semantic_boundaries: U/I/V/T are never collapsed into a scalar risk score
Pareto ordering is a current relative partial order and not a permanent responsibility score
Participation has no universal numerical threshold or permanent memory score
Reconstruction axes remain separate and have no universal high/low threshold
historical age or recency does not enter relation participation
Closure has no universal timeout, distance or frame threshold
the verifier receives only the frozen current frame and cannot read future CARLA state
only actual realized and evaluator-closed relation processes enter reusable history
unrealized possibilities are not stored as parallel historical experiences
the evidence ledger never feeds data back into OASIS Core

live_relation_scope.description: The first G3.2 live empirical run uses only the already frozen front-interaction Closure semantics. Non-front decisions may be realized and logged but are not promoted to front-interaction Completed Experiences.
live_relation_scope.decision_relation_separation: Multiple Decision Epochs may occur while one front relation continues. Each epoch may realize only one action, and each front-related realization is independently held pending until the later relation Closure boundary.

traffic_manager_boundary: If Traffic Manager is used by the live host, its synchronization policy must be frozen consistently with synchronous CARLA execution; this supplement does not silently enable or configure Traffic Manager.
